name: game-spell-check
description: Vague words (적당히, 알아서, 대충 …) underlined while you type and secrets in red; a vague prompt with no done condition asks Claude to state one first; your messages drawn as P1 with the done condition

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: off changes nothing; casual marks the draft, asks for a done condition and draws your messages as P1; hardcore also asks when a done condition is missing from any prompt over 200 characters

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: nes, gameboy and amber are made for dark terminals; theme follows your Claude Code theme (use it on a light background)

player.title: Player name
player.description: The name in your message window (P1 · <name>); empty uses your login name
